intro.h2: Small Repairs and Full Remodels, One Call
paragraphs: Oak Lane Remodeling takes on home remodeling of every size. Customers have hired Cameron to tear down an old deck, build new steps, put in a fence and gate, and tile a kitchen backsplash, and he also handles larger basement, kitchen and bathroom remodels.

The reviews are recent, and they keep saying the same things. Cameron is friendly and easy to work with, tells you how long the job is taking and how it is going, and charges fair prices. One customer has had several projects done over a year and a half and says each one leaves him confident his money was well spent.

items.name: Kitchen, bath and basement remodels
items.blurb: A longtime customer notes that Cameron does much larger remodels too, such as basements, kitchens and bathrooms, not just small projects. Bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring are listed among Oak Lane's services. Call to talk through the room you want to change.

image.alt: Photo needed: finished kitchen, bathroom or basement

items.name: Backsplashes and countertops
items.blurb: Cameron installed a kitchen backsplash for one repeat customer, who says the knowledge and expertise behind his work gives confidence every time a project finishes. Countertops are listed as a service as well, so ask about updating both at the same time.

items.name: Steps and decks
items.blurb: Old back steps that were showing their age were rebuilt to look clean, fresh, sturdy and brand new again, in one customer's words. Another family hired Oak Lane to tear down an old deck and build new steps in its place.

items.name: Fences and gates
items.blurb: Oak Lane installs fences and builds gates. One photo shows a double gate of horizontal pressure-treated pine boards with a black latch, set between new posts beside the house. Two reviewers mention new fence and gate work.

image.alt: New double wood gate of horizontal pressure-treated pine boards with a black latch between two houses

items.name: Fireplace and feature walls
items.blurb: Their photos include a living room fireplace wall: a charcoal shiplap surround built out from the wall, a linear electric fireplace, a stained wood beam mantel and a place for the TV above. Ask about interior carpentry like this for your own room.

image.alt: Charcoal shiplap fireplace surround with linear electric fireplace and stained wood beam mantel in a living room

items.title: Kept in the loop
items.text: Cameron kept one family informed on how long the job was taking and how it was progressing, from tearing out the old deck to the new fence.

items.text: Reviewers describe fair pricing and hard work, and one says Cameron's know-how leaves him confident his money is well spent every time a project wraps up.

items.title: A before and after you can see
items.text: One customer wrote that the before and after of their back steps speaks for itself: clean, fresh, sturdy and brand new again, with attention to detail that shows.

items.title: Kind and easy to work with
items.text: Every captured review mentions Cameron by name, calling him friendly, professional and easy to work with, and one points to the kindness in how he does his work.

about.h2: About Cameron and Oak Lane Remodeling
about.text: Oak Lane Remodeling is a remodeler built around Cameron, the name every reviewer mentions. He takes on small jobs like steps, gates and backsplashes and larger remodels of basements, kitchens and bathrooms. Customers describe him as friendly, professional and knowledgeable about remodeling and home maintenance, and they like that he keeps them updated as the work moves along. Some have hired him for project after project over a year and a half. The business is open on weekdays from 7 AM to 4 PM.
about.owner_role: Named in every captured review as the person doing the work; last name and title not published

process.h2: How Working With Oak Lane Goes

steps.title: Call or email
steps.text: Call (740) 403-9449 on a weekday between 7 AM and 4 PM, or email oaklaneremodeling@gmail.com, and describe the project.

steps.title: Look at the job
steps.text: Cameron looks at what you need, from a worn set of steps to a full room, and gives you a price for the work.

steps.title: Work with updates
steps.text: While the work is underway you hear how long the job is taking and how it is going, as reviewers describe.

steps.title: Before and after
steps.text: See the finished result next to the before. Several customers have come straight back with their next project.

items.name: Amanda K.
items.text: We hired Oak Lane to help us tear down an old deck, build new steps, and install a new fence. Cameron was very friendly and professional and easy to work with. He kept us informed on how long the job was taking and progress. Would definitely recommend his work to others. Fair pricing and hard working!

items.name: Michelle S.
items.text:
⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

We couldn’t be happier with the work **Oak Lane Remodeling** did on our steps! The before and after speaks for itself. 🙌

Our old steps were definitely showing their age, and they completely transformed them. They look **clean, fresh, sturdy, and brand new again!** The attention to detail and quality of the work really shows.

Professional, dependable, and did an amazing job from start to finish. We would absolutely recommend **Oak Lane Remodeling** to anyone looking to have work done on their home.

Thank you for giving our back entrance such a much-needed makeover! ❤️.

items.name: Stephen B.
items.text: I have had several projects done by Cameron over the last year and a half. He has done my kitchen backsplash and has built a new gate. Cameron shows a high level of knowledge and expertise when it comes to remodeling projects and overall home repair maintenance that gives me confidence that my money is well spent every time he finishes a project. I am thrilled based on how well it looks I only does Cameron do small projects but he also does much larger remodels like basement kitchen and bathroom if you’re getting any work done to your house I would highly encourage you to reach out to Oaklane remodeling and you will see Cameron’s kindness in how he does his work.

service_area.text: Oak Lane Remodeling does not publish an address or a service area on Google or Facebook yet. The work is done at customers' homes, so call (740) 403-9449 with your town to check whether it is covered. Reviews mention jobs on decks, steps, fences, gates and kitchens, so tell Cameron what you have in mind and where the house is when you call.

items.a: Oak Lane Remodeling is open Monday through Friday from 7 AM to 4 PM and closed on weekends, according to Google. Call (740) 403-9449 during those hours or email oaklaneremodeling@gmail.com, and include a photo or short description of the project if you can.

Yes. Reviewers have hired Oak Lane to rebuild steps, build a gate, install a fence and tile a backsplash. One repeat customer points out that Cameron does small projects and also much larger remodels, like basements, kitchens and bathrooms. Describe the job when you call.

items.q: Do you do kitchen and bathroom remodels?
items.a: Yes. A repeat customer says Cameron handles larger remodels including basement, kitchen and bathroom work, and Oak Lane lists bathroom remodeling, countertops and flooring among its services. Call to talk about the room and get a price for the work.

Prices are not published. Reviewers describe the pricing as fair, and one says he feels his money is well spent every time a project is finished. Ask for a quote on your project, and whether there is any charge for the estimate visit.

Licence, insurance and warranty details are not published on Google or Facebook, so ask Cameron when you call. It is a fair question for any contractor working on steps, decks or a remodel, and a good one to settle before work starts.

final_cta.text: Call Cameron at Oak Lane Remodeling on any weekday.
